title: Sega Ages: Phantasy Star Collection
native_title: セガ・エイジス ファンタシー・スター・コレクション
overview:
I have a memory of once saving this planet...

All four games in the classic Phantasy Star series, complete! Ported to the Saturn with the feel of the originals intact.

Journey across the worlds of the Algol star system, including Palma, Motavia and Dezolis, in four role-playing adventures against the forces of darkness:

- Phantasy Star
- Phantasy Star II: Kaerazaru Toki no Owari ni
- Phantasy Star III: Toki no Keishousha
- Phantasy Star: Sennenki no Owari ni

An art gallery, arranged music and the original TV commercials round out the collection, along with options such as faster walking in II and III. For 1 player, with memory backup support.

僕には、かつてこの星を救ったという記憶がある・・・

名作「ファンタシースター」シリーズ4本を完全網羅！オリジナルのかおりをそのままにサターンへ移植。
